kikuyu: Andũ othe a kũu Jerusalemu makĩigua ũhoro ũcio, na nĩ ũndũ ũcio magĩĩta gĩthaka kĩu na rũthiomi rwao Ekiladama, ũguo nĩ kuuga, Gĩthaka kĩa Thakame.)
english: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’

kikuyu: “Nĩgũkorwo nĩ kwandĩkĩtwo Ibuku-inĩ rĩa Thaburi atĩrĩ, “ ‘Mũciĩ wake ũrokira ihooru; kũroaga mũndũ wa gũtũũra kuo,’ ningĩ gũkaandĩkwo atĩrĩ, “ ‘Ũtongoria wake ũrooywo nĩ mũndũ ũngĩ.’
english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’

kikuyu: nĩguo oe ũtungata ũyũ wa gũtuĩka mũtũmwo, ũrĩa Judasi aatigire nĩguo athiĩ kũrĩa kũrĩ gwake.”
english: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mũthenya wa Bendegothito wakinyire-rĩ, acio othe magĩkorwo maarĩ handũ hamwe.
english: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa maiguire mũgambo ũcio, gĩkundi kĩa andũ gĩgĩcookanĩrĩra kĩgegete, tondũ o mũndũ aamaiguaga makĩaria na rũthiomi rwake kĩũmbe.
english: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

kikuyu: Mamakĩte na makagega makĩũrania atĩrĩ, “Ũũ nĩ kuuga atĩa?”
english: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”

kikuyu: Andũ aya ti arĩĩu, ta ũrĩa mũreciiria. Rĩu nĩ thaa ithatũ tu cia rũciinĩ!
english: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

kikuyu: Aca gũtitariĩ ta ũguo, ũhoro ũyũ nĩguo warĩtio nĩ mũnabii Joeli, akiuga atĩrĩ:
english: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

kikuyu: “Inyuĩ andũ aya a Isiraeli, thikĩrĩriai ũhoro ũyũ: Jesũ wa Nazarethi aarĩ mũndũ waheanĩtwo nĩ Ngai kũrĩ inyuĩ na ũndũ wa ciama, na morirũ, na cionereria, iria Ngai aaringire gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu agereire harĩ we, o ta ũrĩa inyuĩ ene mũũĩ.
english: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngoro yakwa nĩnjanjamũku, naruo rũrĩmĩ rwakwa rũgakena; o naguo mwĩrĩ wakwa nĩũgũtũũra ũrĩ na mwĩhoko,
english: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,

kikuyu: Nowe aarĩ mũnabii na nĩamenyete atĩ Ngai nĩamwĩrire na mwĩhĩtwa atĩ nĩagaikarĩria ũmwe wa rũciaro rwake gĩtĩ gĩake kĩa ũnene.
english: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,

kikuyu: makagoocaga Ngai, na magetĩkĩrĩka kũrĩ andũ othe. Nake Mwathani nĩongagĩrĩra thiritũ-inĩ yao andũ arĩa maahonokaga o mũthenya.
english: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

kikuyu: Mwakaanire Ũrĩa Mũtheru na Mũthingu mũkiuga muohorerwo mũũragani.
english: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

kikuyu: kĩmenyei inyuĩ, o na andũ othe a Isiraeli atĩrĩ: Mũndũ ũyũ arũngiĩ mbere yanyu arĩ mũhonu nĩ ũndũ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Jesũ Kristũ wa Nazarethi, ũrĩa mwambithirie, nake Ngai akĩmũriũkia kuuma kũrĩ arĩa akuũ.
english: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.

kikuyu: Na thuutha wa kũmakaania, maamehĩire mũno, makĩmarekereria mathiĩ. Matingĩahotire gũtua ũrĩa mangĩamaherithirie, tondũ andũ othe nĩmagoocaga Ngai nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa gwekĩkĩte.
english: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa maiguire ũhoro ũcio, makĩanĩrĩra marĩ ngoro ĩmwe makĩhooya Ngai, makiuga atĩrĩ, “Mwathani Jehova, nĩwe wombire igũrũ na thĩ na iria, o na indo ciothe iria irĩ kuo.
english: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

kikuyu: Nowe Petero akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Anania, nĩ kĩĩ ngoro yaku ĩiyũrĩtwo nĩ Shaitani ũguo, agatũma ũheenie Roho Mũtheru, na ũgetigĩria mbeeca imwe cia iria wendetie gĩthaka?
english: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?

kikuyu: Nao aanake magĩũka, makĩoha mwĩrĩ wake na cuka, makĩuumia nja na makĩũthika.
english: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, ruoro rũgĩtema magĩtoonya hekarũ-inĩ, na makĩambĩrĩria kũruta andũ o ta ũrĩa meerĩĩtwo. Rĩrĩamũthĩnjĩri-Ngaiũrĩamũnenenaandũarĩamaakoragwonakemaakinyire-rĩ, magĩcookanĩrĩria Kĩama, kĩũngano gĩa athuuri othe a Isiraeli, na magĩtũmana njeera atũmwo magĩĩrwo.
english: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

kikuyu: Petero na atũmwo acio angĩ magĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Ithuĩ no nginya twathĩkĩre Ngai gũkĩra gwathĩkĩra andũ!
english: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

kikuyu: Ithuĩ tũrĩ aira a maũndũ macio, nake Roho Mũtheru, ũrĩa Ngai aheete andũ arĩa mamwathĩkagĩra-rĩ, o nake nĩ mũira.”
english: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Mũfarisai wetagwo Gamalieli, mũrutani wa watho na watĩĩtwo nĩ andũ othe akĩrũgama Kĩama-inĩ, agĩathana atĩ andũ acio mambe moimio nja gwa kahinda kanini.
english: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, igũrũ rĩkoniĩ ũhoro ũyũ ngũmũtaara atĩrĩ, tiganai na andũ aya! Marekeei mathiĩ! Nĩ ũndũ angĩkorwo muoroto kana ciĩko ciao ciumanĩte na ũmũndũ-rĩ, ũndũ ũcio nĩũgũthira.
english: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

kikuyu: Mũthenya o mũthenya, marĩ hekarũ-inĩ o na marĩ mĩciĩ-inĩ, matiigana gũtiga kũrutana na kũhunjia ũhoro ũcio mwega atĩ Jesũ nĩwe Kristũ.
english: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, matukũ-inĩ macio rĩrĩa mũigana wa arutwo wongererekaga-rĩ, Ayahudi amwe arĩa maa- ciarĩirwo kwa Ayunani nĩmatetirie Ayahudi a Kĩhibirania tondũ atumia ao a ndigwa matiagayagĩrwo irio rĩrĩa ikũgayanwo o mũthenya.
english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

kikuyu: no matingĩetiiririe ũũgĩ wake kana Roho ũrĩa aaragia naguo.
english: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

kikuyu: Ndaamũheire igai gũkũ, o na ikinya rĩmwe. No Ngai nĩamwĩrire atĩ we hamwe na njiaro ciake nĩmakegwatĩra bũrũri ũyũ, o na gũtuĩka hĩndĩ ĩyo Iburahĩmu ndaarĩ na mwana.
english: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

kikuyu: Ngai eerire Iburahĩmu atĩrĩ: ‘Njiaro ciaku igaatũũra irĩ ngʼeni bũrũri ũtarĩ wacio, kũrĩa igaatuuo ngombo na inyariirwo ihinda rĩa mĩaka magana mana.’
english: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jakubu aiguire atĩ Misiri nĩ kwarĩ na ngano, agĩtũma maithe maitũ kuo hĩndĩ ya mbere.
english: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

kikuyu: Nĩmũtũũgĩrĩtie ihooero rĩa Moleku, na njata ya ngai yanyu ĩrĩa ĩĩtagwo Refani, mĩhianano ĩrĩa mwathondekire ya kũhooyaga. Tondũ ũcio, nĩngatũma mũtahwo mũtwarwo’ kũhĩtũka Babuloni.
english: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’

kikuyu: “No rĩrĩ, Ũrĩa-ũrĩ-Igũrũ-Mũno ndaikaraga nyũmba ciakĩtwo nĩ andũ. O ta ũrĩa mũnabii oigĩte atĩrĩ:
english: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

kikuyu: No Saũlũ akĩambĩrĩria kwananga kanitha. Aathiiaga nyũmba o nyũmba, akĩrutũrũraga arũme na andũ-a-nja, akĩmaikagia njeera.
english: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio gũkĩgĩa na gĩkeno kĩnene itũũra-inĩ rĩu.
english: There was great joy in that city.

kikuyu: tondũ nginya hĩndĩ ĩyo Roho Mũtheru ndaakoretwo aikũrũkĩire mũndũ o na ũmwe wao; tiga o kũbatithio maabatithĩtio thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Mwathani Jesũ.
english: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũraika wa Mwathani akĩĩra Filipu atĩrĩ, “Thiĩ werekeire gũthini, ũkinye njĩra-inĩ, njĩra ĩrĩa ya werũ-inĩ, ĩrĩa ĩikũrũkĩte kuuma Jerusalemu ĩgathiĩ nginya Gaza.”
english: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”

kikuyu: Na marĩ njĩra-inĩ magĩthiĩ-rĩ, magĩkinya handũ haarĩ na maaĩ, nake mũndũ ũcio warĩ mũhakũre akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ta rora, maaĩ nĩmo maya. Nĩ kĩĩ kĩngĩgiria mbatithio?”
english: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ maamenyire ũguo, makĩmuoya, makĩmũikũrũkia nginya Kaisarea, makĩmũtũma Tariso.
english: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

kikuyu: Na Petero o akĩaragia ciugo icio-rĩ, Roho Mũtheru agĩikũrũkĩra andũ arĩa othe maiguire ndũmĩrĩri ĩyo.
english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

kikuyu: Ũndũ ũyũ wekĩkire maita matatũ, nakĩo gĩtama kĩu gĩkĩguucio na igũrũ.
english: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

kikuyu: Nake agĩtwĩra ũrĩa oimĩrĩirwo nĩ mũraika arĩ gwake nyũmba, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Tũmana Jopa wĩtĩrwo Simoni ũrĩa wĩtagwo Petero.
english: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ngĩririkana ũrĩa Mwathani oigĩte atĩrĩ, ‘Johana aabatithanagia na maaĩ, no inyuĩ mũkaabatithio na Roho Mũtheru.’
english: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’

kikuyu: Nake Baranaba agĩthiĩ Tariso gũcaria Saũlũ,
english: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa oonire ũhoro ũcio nĩwakenia Ayahudi-rĩ, akĩnyiitithia Petero o nake. Ũndũ ũcio wekĩkire hĩndĩ ya Gĩathĩ kĩa Mĩgate Ĩtarĩ Mĩĩkĩre Ndawa ya Kũimbia.
english: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

kikuyu: Mũraikaũcioagĩcookaakĩmwĩraatĩrĩ, “Wĩhumbenguociakunawĩkĩreiraatũ.” NakePeteroagĩĩka o ũguo. Mũraika ũcio akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Wĩhotore nguo yaku na ũnũmĩrĩre.”
english: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa aguũkĩirwo nĩ ũhoro ũcio, agĩthiĩ kwa Mariamu ũrĩa warĩ nyina wa Johana, na nowe wetagwo Mariko, na nĩkuo andũ aingĩ monganĩte makĩhooya Ngai.
english: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

kikuyu: Ngai wa andũ a Isiraeli nĩathuurire maithe maitũ; agĩtũma andũ acio matheereme hĩndĩ ĩrĩa maatũũraga Misiri, na akĩmaruta bũrũri ũcio na hinya mũnene,
english: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

kikuyu: akĩniina ndũrĩrĩ mũgwanja kũu Kaanani naguo bũrũri wacio akĩũhe andũ aake ũtuĩke igai rĩao.
english: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.

kikuyu: na kwa ihinda rĩa mĩthenya mĩingĩ nĩonirwo nĩ andũ arĩa moimĩte nao Galili, magathiĩ Jerusalemu. Na rĩu acio nĩo aira aake kũrĩ andũ aitũ.
english: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

kikuyu: No ũrĩa Ngai aariũkirie kuuma kũrĩ arĩa akuũ ndaabuthire.
english: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

kikuyu: No Ayahudi magĩakĩrĩria atumia arĩa meyamũrĩire Ngai na maarĩ igweta, o na anene a itũũra inene. Makĩrutithia ngũĩ ya gũũkĩrĩra Paũlũ na Baranaba nĩguo manyariirwo, na makĩmaingata moime bũrũri-inĩ wao.
english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

kikuyu: No Ayahudi arĩa maaregire gwĩtĩkia nĩmathogothire andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ, makĩmathũkia meciiria nĩgeetha mookĩrĩre ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ.
english: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

kikuyu: Aca! Twĩtĩkĩtie atĩ tũhonokete nĩ ũndũ wa wega wa Mwathani witũ Jesũ, o ta ũrĩa o nao mahonokete.”
english: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa maarĩkirie kwaria, Jakubu akĩaria akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, ta thikĩrĩriai.
english: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩtwatũma Judasi na Sila nĩgeetha makindĩre ũhoro ũyũ tũramwandĩkĩra na ciugo cia tũnua twao.
english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa maathiiaga kuuma itũũra nginya rĩrĩa rĩngĩ, nĩmeeraga andũ matua marĩa maatuĩtwo nĩ atũmwo na athuuri kũu Jerusalemu nĩguo andũ mamaathĩkagĩre.
english: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Twaarĩkia kuuma Teroa, tũgĩthiĩ na marikabu twerekeire Samotherake, na mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ tũgĩthiĩ Neapoli.
english: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

kikuyu: Kuuma kũu tũgĩthiĩ Filipi, kũrĩa gwathagwo nĩ andũ a Roma, na nĩrĩo rĩarĩ itũũra rĩrĩa inene rĩa bũrũri ũcio wa Makedonia. Na tũgĩikara kũu mĩthenya ĩtaarĩ mĩingĩ.
english: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩmwe tũgĩthiĩ harĩa haahooyagĩrwo Ngai, nĩtwatũngirwo nĩ mũirĩtu warĩ ngombo na nĩarĩ na roho wa kũragũra. Nake nĩatũmaga ene we meonere mbeeca nyingĩ mũno nĩ ũndũ wa ũragũri wake
english: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

kikuyu: Nakĩo kĩrĩndĩ gĩgĩũkĩrĩra Paũlũ na Sila kĩmeeke ũũru no aciirithania makĩruta watho atĩ marutwo nguo na mahũũrwo iboko.
english: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa maamaagire, magĩkururia Jasoni na ariũ a Ithe witũ amwe, makĩmarehe kũrĩ anene a itũũra, makĩanagĩrĩra atĩrĩ: “Andũ aya nĩo marehete thĩĩna thĩ yothe, na rĩu nĩmookĩte gũkũ,
english: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

kikuyu: Ayahudi aingĩ nĩmetĩkirie, o ũndũ ũmwe na atumia aingĩ a Ayunani arĩa maarĩ igweta, o na andũ arũme aingĩ Ayunani.
english: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

kikuyu: Tũraigua ũgĩtwarĩria maũndũ mageni, na nĩtũkwenda kũmenya ũrĩa moigĩte.”
english: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”

kikuyu: ‘Nĩgũkorwo nĩ thĩinĩ wake tũtũũraga na tũgetwara, na tũgakorwo tũrĩ muoyo.’ O ta ũrĩa aandĩki amwe a nyĩmbo cianyu moigĩte atĩrĩ, ‘Ithuĩ tũrĩ a rũciaro rwake.’
english: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

kikuyu: O mũthenya wa Thabatũ nĩaheanaga ũhoro thunagogi-inĩ, akĩgeria kũiguithia Ayahudi na Ayunani.
english: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa Ayahudi maakararirie Paũlũ na makĩmũruma, akĩribariba nguo ciake nĩ ũndũ wa kũngʼũrĩka na akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Thakame yanyu ĩromũcookerera! Niĩ ndirĩ ũndũ ingĩũrio nĩ ũndũ wanyu. Kuuma rĩu ngũcooka gũthiĩ kũrĩ andũ- a-Ndũrĩrĩ.”
english: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa Paũlũ endaga kwaria, Galio akĩĩra Ayahudi atĩrĩ, “Korwo inyuĩ Ayahudi mũrateta nĩ ũndũ wa ũndũ mũũru kana ngero njũru-rĩ, nĩ hangĩrĩ na gĩtũmi gĩa kũmũthikĩrĩria inyuĩ.
english: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

kikuyu: O ihinda-inĩ rĩu, Mũyahudi wetagwo Apolo, waciarĩirwo Alekisanderia, agĩũka Efeso. Aarĩ mũndũmũthomu, naaarĩnaũũgĩmũingĩmũnowaMaandĩko.
english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

kikuyu: NĩarutĩtwonanjĩraĩrĩayaMwathani, na akaaragia na kĩyo kĩnene, na akarutanaga ũhoro wa Jesũ atekũhĩtia, o na gũtuĩka ũbatithio ũrĩa ooĩ warĩ o wa Johana.
english: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

kikuyu: Nake akĩambĩrĩria kwaria na ũcamba kũu thunagogi-inĩ. Rĩrĩa Pirisila na Akula maamũiguire akĩaria, makĩmũnyiita ũgeni kwao mũciĩ na makĩmũtaarĩria ũhoro wa njĩra ya Ngai wega makĩria.
english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

kikuyu: Akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Nĩmwamũkĩrire Roho Mũtheru rĩrĩa mwetĩkirie?” Nao makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Aca, ithuĩ o na tũtirĩ twaigua atĩ nĩ kũrĩ Roho Mũtheru.”
english: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Paũlũ akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Ũbatithio wa Johana warĩ ũbatithio wa kwĩrira kwa mehia. Eeraga andũ metĩkie ũrĩa ũgũũka thuutha wake, nake nĩwe Jesũ.”
english: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”

kikuyu: Ũndũ ũyũ nĩwathiire na mbere ihinda ta rĩa mĩaka ĩĩrĩ, o nginya Ayahudi na Ayunani othe arĩa maatũũraga bũrũri wa Asia makĩigua kiugo kĩa Mwathani.
english: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

kikuyu: Ariũ mũgwanja a Mũyahudi wetagwo Sikeva, warĩ mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai mũnene, nĩmekaga ũguo.
english: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo mũndũ ũcio warĩ na ngoma thũku akĩmarũgĩrĩra akĩmatooria othe. Akĩmahũũra mũno nginya makiuma nyũmba ĩyo makĩũra marĩ njaga makiuraga thakame.
english: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

kikuyu: Na thuutha wa kahinda kanini itũũra rĩu rĩkĩiyũra inegene. Andũ acio othe makĩnyiita Gayo na Arisitariko arĩa moimĩte Makedonia na Paũlũ, nao makĩhanyũka marĩ ngoro ĩmwe magĩtoonya nyũmba ĩrĩa yagomanagwo nĩ ũndũ wa kuona mĩago.
english: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.

kikuyu: Hakĩrĩ ũguo-rĩ, angĩkorwo Demeterio na andũ acio angĩ marutaga wĩra nake marĩ na mateta igũrũ rĩa mũndũ o wothe, maciirĩro nĩmahingũre na aciirithania marĩ ho. No mamathitange.
english: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.

kikuyu: Paũlũ agĩikũrũka, agĩkomera mwanake ũcio akĩmũkumbatĩria akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Tigai kũmaka, arĩ muoyo!”
english: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”

kikuyu: No ithuĩ tũgĩthiĩ mbere tũgĩtoonya marikabu tũgĩthiĩ nginya Aso, kũrĩa twathiire tũkĩoyaga Paũlũ. Aathondekete mũbango ũyũ mbere tondũ we athiĩte kũu magũrũ.
english: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa aatũtũngire kũu Aso, tũkĩmũkuua na marikabu, tũgĩthiĩ nginya Mitilene.
english: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ ene nĩmũũĩ atĩ ndaarutaga wĩra na moko makwa nĩ ũndũ wa mabata makwa niĩ mwene, na mabata ma andũ arĩa ndakoragwo nao.
english: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.

kikuyu: No ihinda riitũ rĩathira, tũkiuma kũu, tũgĩthiĩ na mbere na rũgendo rwitũ. Arutwo othe, hamwe na atumia ao na ciana ciao, magĩtuumagaria, magĩtũkinyia nja ya itũũra, na tũrĩ hau hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia iria, tũgĩturia ndu, tũkĩhooya Ngai.
english: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ Paũlũ, na andũ arĩa twarĩ nao tũgĩthiĩ kuona Jakubu, nao athuuri othe maarĩ ho.
english: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

kikuyu: Nake Paũlũ akĩmageithia na akĩmeera ũrĩa wothe Ngai eekĩire andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ agereire ũtungata-inĩ wake.
english: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

kikuyu: Nao nĩmamenyithĩtio atĩ nĩ ũrutaga Ayahudi othe arĩa matũũranagia na andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ atĩ magarũrũke matigane na watho wa Musa, ũkĩmeeraga matikaruithie ciana ciao na matigaikare kũringana na mĩtugo iitũ.
english: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa thigari ciarĩ o hakuhĩ gũtoonyia Paũlũ nyũmba ya thigari-rĩ, akĩũria mũnene wacio atĩrĩ, “Nĩũkũnjĩtĩkĩria ngwĩre ũndũ?” Nake mũnene ũcio akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Wee anga nĩwaragia Kĩyunani?
english: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?

kikuyu: “Nake Mwathani akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Thiĩ, tondũ nĩngũgũtũma kũndũ kũraya kwa andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ.’ ”
english: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”

kikuyu: Nake Anania mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũrĩa mũnene, agĩatha andũ arĩa maarũgamĩte hakuhĩ na Paũlũ mamũringe kanua.
english: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Paũlũ aamenya atĩ amwe ao maarĩ Asadukai, na arĩa angĩ Afarisai, akĩanĩrĩra Kĩama-inĩ kĩu, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ariũ a Baba, niĩ ndĩ Mũfarisai, na njiarĩtwo nĩ Mũfarisai. Ndĩraciirithio nĩ ũndũ wa kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro gĩakwa gĩa kũriũkio kwa arĩa akuũ.”
english: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”

kikuyu: (Asadukai moigaga gũtirĩ ũriũkio, na gũtirĩ araika, o na kana maroho, no Afarisai nĩmetĩkĩtie maũndũ macio mothe.)
english: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.

kikuyu: Nacio ngarari ikĩneneha mũno, o nginya mũnene wa mbũtũ akĩigua guoya nĩkuona ta Paũlũ angĩtarũrangwo tũcunjĩ nĩo. Agĩatha mbũtũ cia thigari ciikũrũke, imweherie harĩo na hinya, na imũtware nyũmba ya thigari.
english: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.

kikuyu: Nake mwanake ũcio akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Ayahudi nĩmaiguanĩire makũũrie ũmarehere Paũlũ nĩguo arũgame mbere ya kĩama rũciũ, metuĩte ta marenda gũtuĩria ũhoro wake wega.
english: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.

kikuyu: Na ningĩ mũhaarĩrie mbarathi cia gũkuua Paũlũ atwarwo kũrĩ Felike ũrĩa barũthi hatarĩ na ũgwati.”
english: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.

kikuyu: Nake barũthi aathoma marũa, akĩũria kũrĩa Paũlũ oimĩte. Rĩrĩa aamenyire atĩ oimĩte Kilikia,
english: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,

kikuyu: No nĩgeetha ndigakũnogie makĩria, nĩngũkũũria na gĩtĩĩo ũtũthikĩrĩrie hanini.
english: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Paũlũ aakinyire, Ayahudi arĩa maikũrũkĩte kuuma Jerusalemu makĩmũrigiicĩria, na makĩmũthitangĩra maũndũ maingĩ mooru, marĩa matangĩahotire kuonania atĩ nĩ ma ma.
english: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Paũlũ aacookirie ciira riiko etererio itua rĩa Mũthamaki-rĩ, ngĩathana ahingĩrwo nginya rĩrĩa ingĩahotire kũmũtwarithia kũrĩ Kaisari.”
english: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”

kikuyu: “O na niĩ nĩndaiguithĩtio atĩ nĩndagĩrĩirwo nĩ gwĩka ũrĩa wothe ingĩahotire ndegane na rĩĩtwa rĩa Jesũ wa Nazarethi.
english: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

kikuyu: “Na niĩ hĩndĩ ĩyo ngĩũria atĩrĩ, ‘Wee nĩwe ũ, Mwathani?’ “Nake Mwathani akĩnjookeria atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩ niĩ Jesũ ũrĩa ũnyariiraga.
english: “I said, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “He said, ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

kikuyu: ũkamahingũre maitho, na ũmagarũre moime nduma-inĩ mathiĩ ũtheri-inĩ, na ũmarute hinya-inĩ wa Shaitani ũmatware kũrĩ Ngai, nĩgeetha maamũkĩre ũrekanĩri wa mehia, na magĩe na handũ gatagatĩ-inĩ ka andũ arĩa matheretio na ũndũ wa kũnjĩtĩkia.’
english: to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’

kikuyu: Na ihinda rĩtanathiĩ mũno, rũhuho rwa hinya wa kĩhuhũkanio kĩnene rwetagwo “Eurakilo,” rũkĩhu- rutana ruumĩte gĩcigĩrĩra-inĩ kĩu.
english: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.

kikuyu: Nayo marikabu ĩkĩnyiitwo nĩ kĩhuhũkanio kĩu ĩkĩremwo nĩgũthiĩ nakũrĩarũhuhorwoimaga, nĩũndũũciotũkĩmĩrekereriaĩtwarwonĩrũhuho.
english: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa andũ acio maakahaicirie marikabu-inĩ, makĩhĩtũkĩria mĩkanda rungu rwa marikabu yo nyene nĩgeetha mamĩohe wega. Nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩtigĩra kũhata mũthanga-inĩ wa handũ heetagwo Siriti-rĩ, makĩharũrũkia matanga na makĩrekereria marikabu ĩyo ĩtwarwo o kũrĩa ĩngĩatwarirwo nĩ rũhuho.
english: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, nĩngũmũthaitha mũthiĩ na mbere kũũmĩrĩria, tondũ gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wanyu ũkũũra; tiga marikabu iiki ĩkwanangĩka.
english: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, inyuĩ andũ aya, thiĩi na mbere kũũmĩrĩria, nĩgũkorwo ndĩ na wĩtĩkio thĩinĩ wa Ngai atĩ nĩgũkũhaana o ta ũguo aanjĩĩrĩte.
english: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.

kikuyu: No o na kũrĩ ũguo no nginya tũhate gĩcigĩrĩra-inĩ kĩna.”
english: But we must run aground on a certain island.”

kikuyu: Twakinya Sirakusi tũgĩikara kuo ihinda rĩa thikũ ithatũ.
english: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.

kikuyu: Nao magĩĩthuthuuria na makĩenda kũndekia tondũ ndiarĩ na ihĩtia rĩa ũgeri wa ngero rĩa gũtũma njũragwo.
english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, nĩngwenda mũmenye atĩ ũhonokio wa Ngai nĩũtũmĩtwo kũrĩ andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ, nao nĩmegũthikĩrĩria!”
english: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”

kikuyu: Nĩkĩĩ gĩtũmaga bũrũri wa Kenya wonekane wĩna rĩera rĩega rĩa kũrĩma makorobia?
english: Why does Kenya present a favourable climate to avocado production?

kikuyu: tĩĩri ũtarĩ mũnyitu ta wa rĩũmba, wĩna mũthanga, ũtaraiga maaĩ na wĩna ũrũrũ wa gatagatĩ ka 5-7.
english: Loose, sandy or loamy soils, well-draining with pH ranging 5-7;

kikuyu: Mĩthemba ya mĩtĩ irĩa mĩhande nĩyo ĩgũteithia kũgĩa na maciaro marĩa merĩgĩrĩirũo.
english: The type of avocado cultivars planted in an orchard will contribute to the expected yield.

kikuyu: Nĩwega kũiga mĩatũ ya njũkĩ thĩinĩ wa mĩgũnda ya makorobia nĩũndũ njũkĩ nĩcio irutaga wĩra ũrĩa mũingĩ wa gũciarithania mĩtĩ ya mĩthemba ngũrani ya makorobia
english: The presence of bee hives within the orchard is recommended as bees are the main pollinators of avocado.

kikuyu: Hihi maũndũ ma bata ũkũria-inĩ wa mĩkorobia nĩ marĩkũ?
english: What are essential elements in avocado production?

kikuyu: Hihi mawega ma gũceha mĩtĩ ya mĩkorobia nĩmarĩkũ?
english: What are the advantages of grafting in avocado production?

kikuyu: Nĩ kũongagĩrĩra hinya wa mĩtĩ kũrũa na mĩrimũ.
english: Increases resistance to diseases;

kikuyu: Kũhũrana na ria
english: weed control;

kikuyu: Ũthuthuria wa dry matter. Dry matter ĩringanaga na mũthemba wa mũkorobia, itũra rĩrĩa ikorobia rĩu rĩkũrĩirio, na kĩmera.
english: Dry matter analysis.Dry matter is dependent on variety, region and season.

kikuyu: Makorobia no maigwo kũndũ kũrĩ na ũrugarĩ mũnini (ithimo-inĩ coa 20oC) kwa ihinda ria kiumia kĩmwe.
english: Fruits can be stored in a warm place (about 20 degrees temperatures) for a week.

kikuyu: Nĩguo gĩtira kia mũgũnda kiagĩre, arĩmĩ a matunda magĩrĩirwo kũhanda mĩmera ya kĩmera kĩmwe mwaka ũmwe mbere ya kũhanda matunda.
english: To achieve a good tilth of the cleared land, fruit growers are advised to plant an annual crop a year before starting fruit cultivation.

kikuyu: Kaingĩ mĩtĩ ya Fuerte na Hass ĩtaganagio na mĩta kenda gwa kenda (Mĩtĩ igana rĩmwe rĩa mĩrongo ĩrĩ harĩ o hactare)
english: Fuerte and Hass are typically spaced at 9 x 9m (120 plants/ ha).

kikuyu: Hihi mĩkorobia ĩrĩa ĩhũthagĩrũo kũruta mbeũ ĩkoragwo na ngumo ĩrĩkũ?
english: What are the characteristics of mother trees to collect seed from?

kikuyu: tĩĩri ũrĩa wĩkĩragwo mĩnyore-inĩ ya mĩũngũrwa ũbatiĩ gũkorwo ũhana atĩa?
english: What are features of potting media?

kikuyu: Ũtheru wa mũgũnda:
english: Orchard sanitation:

kikuyu: Kũmunya kwa mĩtĩ yoothe mĩrwaru.
english: Uprooting of affected trees.

kikuyu: Nĩ maũndũ marĩkũ monanagia atĩ mĩri ya mĩkorobia nĩrabutha na mũrimũ ũyũ ũngĩgirĩrĩrio atĩa?
english: What are the symptoms of root rot in avocado production and how can it be controlled?

kikuyu: Mũrimũ ũyũ ũrigagĩrĩrio na njĩra ya kũiga mũgũnda ũrĩ mũtheru na dawa cia kũnina fungi
english: It is controlled by proper orchard sanitation and use of fungicides.

kikuyu: Mbareti ibatiĩ gũthambio na maaĩ mahiũ thĩinĩwa nyũmba ĩrĩa yendekithĩtio nĩ KEPHIS
english: The pallets should be hot water treated in a KEPHIS authorized facility

kikuyu: Kaingĩ mũthemba wa Hass ũkũragio nĩũndũ wa thoko cia rũraya nayo Fuerte ĩkoragwo ya gũthondeka magũta.
english: Hass is the main export variety and Fuerte is preferred for processing.

kikuyu: Ningĩ ikorobia rĩkoragwo rĩhana mũbira kana ovo.
english: It is round or oval in shape;

kikuyu: rĩgakorwo rĩrĩ inyoroku, na mũrĩo
english: It has a smooth, nutty and sweet taste

kikuyu: Rĩũnũkaga na ũhũthũ
english: It peels easily;

kikuyu: Mĩkorobia ya Hass ĩciaraga matunda maingĩ kũrĩ mĩthemba ĩngĩ ya mĩkorobia.
english: Hass avocado trees have high yields compared to other varieties.

kikuyu: Tondũ makorobia ma Hass makoragwo mũthemba ũrĩa mũtuku, manjagia gũcenjia rangi kuuma ngirini nginya papo njamu ĩrairĩrĩra.
english: Since Hass avocado is a dark variety it starts to change color from green to black or purple;

kikuyu: Mĩrimũ ĩrehagwo nĩ matumbĩ: ĩno nĩ mĩrimũ ĩrĩa ĩtambagio nĩ matumbĩ kuuma kũrĩ ngũkũ iria ndwaru nginya kũrĩ njui. Mĩrimũ ĩno ĩmwe no ĩkorwo ĩrĩ thĩinĩ wa ĩtumbĩ kana igũrũ wa ikorogosha ta mũrimũ wa Salmonellosis
english: Egg-borne diseases: these are passed from infected hen to new hatched chicks. Some diseases are carried inside the egg shell while others are just on the shell surface e.g. Salmonellosis

kikuyu: Indo cia wĩra: Kũhoyana indo cia wĩra ikũĩte mĩrimũ kuuma mũgũnda-inĩ ũmwe nginya ũria ũngĩ na kwaga gũthambia wega indo cia kũrĩra na kũrũgĩra.
english: Equipment: sharing of contaminated equipment between farms and failure to clean utensils

kikuyu: Nyoni nĩciagaga thuti wa kũrĩa na ikenda gũikara cinamĩrĩire.
english: Birds lose appetite and are droopy.

kikuyu: Indo ingĩ ikuĩte mũrimũ ũyũ ta nguo, matandĩko, indo cia wĩra, ona indo ingĩ no iteithĩe gũtheremia mũrimũ ũyũ.
english: Contaminated clothes, beddings, equipment, and other materials can spread the disease to a flock.

kikuyu: Ngũkũ ici ningĩ ikomaga igũithĩtie mũtwe kana ikaũroria nathutha kana ikaũhitha ithagu-inĩ.
english: The birds also sit with the head down or turned backward or rested in feathers around the wing.

kikuyu: Mũno makĩria ũnyitaga ngũkũ irĩ na ũkũrũ wa ciumia igĩrĩ nginya ciumia ikũmi, na ngũkũ ĩka hinyĩrĩrĩka na njĩra nene.
english: It usually occurs at eight to 10 weeks of age and normally expresses itself in acute and chronic forms.

kikuyu: Kũrigita mũrimũ wa kihuruto: ũndũ mwega nĩ ati, mũrimũ ũyũ ũngimenyeka tene no ũrigitike raithi.
english: Treatment of Coccidiosis: Good thing, Coccidiosis if noticed early, it can be treated easily.

kikuyu: Dawa ya amprolium nĩyo ĩhũthĩkaga kaingĩ kũrigita mũrimũ wa kĩhuruto. ĩkoragwo na ũhoti wa kũnina hinya wa njamuthi ikaremwo gũciarana.
english: Amprolium is the most common treatment of Coccidiosis. It weakens the parasite’s ability to multiply.

kikuyu: Ũrũrũ wa mũrimũ ũringanaga na mũthemba wa njamuthi na uhoti wa ngũku wa kurua na mĩrimũ.
english: Disease severity depends on the type of virus and immunity of the birds.

kikuyu: Hebata ngũkũ iria irĩ na ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ ikorwo nĩcio ikũheo njanjo ĩno.
english: It is important to vaccinate only healthy chicken.

kikuyu: Hihi batiĩ gũĩka atĩa ngũkũ ciakwa cianyitwo nĩ mũrimũ wa Gũmboro?
english: What to do when your birds are infected with gumboro disease?

kikuyu: Njanjo nĩcionekaga na ibatiĩ kũhuthĩka harĩ tũcui twa ũkũru wa mũthenya ũmwe na ngũkũ iria itarĩ ndwaru kwa njĩra ya gũtheca ithagu-inĩ.
english: Vaccines are available for use in day-old chicks and unaffected adult birds using the wing-stab method.

kikuyu: Glucose, dawa ya kũũraga njamuthi mũthemba wa tetracycline ona multivitamins no cĩikĩrwo maaĩ-inĩ ma kũnyua.
english: Glucose, tetracycline and multivitamins can be administered in drinking water.

kikuyu: Ngũkũ cia gĩcenjĩ irĩaga irio cia mĩthemba yothe hamwe na mũthemba wa mbembe, igunyũ na mahuti.
english: Kienyeji chickens are omnivorous and will eat a variety of foods, including grains, insects, and greens.

kikuyu: Hihi njĩra cia kũrĩithia ngũkũ bũrũri-inĩ wa Kenya nĩ irĩkũ?
english: Which farming systems or methods of poultry exist in Kenya

kikuyu: Kaingĩ, bamĩrĩ na makĩria atumia na ciana, nĩo matungataga ngũkũ.
english: Mainly use family labour and are cared for mostly by women and children

kikuyu: Ngũkũ ikoragwo ihingĩirwo mahinda me mothe, no nĩikoragwo na wĩyathi wa kũrũra nĩundũ wa kĩwanja kĩariĩ.
english: Your chicken are kept indoors all the time, but they have large space to move around freely.

kikuyu: Ngũkũ iheagwo gĩthimi kĩnini kĩa irio ithondekeirwo mũciĩ kana mbembe mbere ya ihingũrĩirwo.
english: Chicken are fed with small amounts of home-made chicken feed or maize grains before you can release them in the morning.

kikuyu: Ngũkũ ciacoka hwaĩ-inĩ, icokaga igaikĩrĩo irio nini.
english: When chickens come back in the evening they are again fed with supplements.

kikuyu: Ũrĩithi ũyũ nĩũrĩ raithi gũkira wa kũhingĩra kĩnji-inĩ.
english: It is economical than cage systems.

kikuyu: kĩaga kĩagĩrĩire gũkorwo na huhĩrio njega cia rĩera.
english: The house should be well ventilated

kikuyu: kũringana na ũthuthuria, mĩrekerie ya matumbĩ, kũnyihia ũitangi wa irio na ũritũ wa matumbĩ ma ngũkũ ihingĩrĩtwo kĩnjĩ-inĩ nĩ wongererekaga gũkira ĩrĩa cia marĩa ma ngũkũ cĩa kũrekio irĩ hamwe kĩaga-inĩ kĩa mahuti.
english: Egg production, feed efficiency and egg weight of caged layers is more than in deep litter systems according to research

kikuyu: Ũtungata wa ngũkũ; kiugũ gĩa kũgũithia thumu, kiugũ gĩa gũciga irĩhamwe, gũcirekia ciĩmathĩre, mũtukanio wa kũhingĩra na kũrekia ciĩmathĩre nĩcio njĩra iria iheaga ngũkũ ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩũkĩringithania na tũthandũku twakĩtwo kĩaga harĩa ngũkũ igĩaga thĩna wa kuonja nĩũndũ wa kwaga gũceera.
english: Animal welfare; slatted systems, deep litter, free range and semi intensive chicken rearing is considered to provide chicken with better health unlike cage system with many inherent welfare problems from restricted movements.

kikuyu: Itũmi cia kũrĩithia ngũkũ: cia biacara, kũrĩithia ngũkũ ihingĩirwo nĩyo njĩra njega ĩrongoragĩrĩria baita nĩũndũ nĩikũraga narua.
english: Purpose of production; for commercial production, intensive production systems are better than free range systems that has low yields and profitability

kikuyu: Mĩharatĩ ĩtũmĩkaga kũhe ngũkũ irio. Nĩ yagĩrĩire gũthambagio kaingĩ nĩgetha kũgiria gũtherema kwa mĩrimũ.
english: Are used to give food to the chickens. Should be cleaned regularly to prevent spread of diseases

kikuyu: Maũndũ maya nĩmo mabatiĩ kwandĩkwo nĩ mũrĩmi thĩinĩ wa rekodi;
english: The following information should be recorded by the farmers

kikuyu: Kũngĩhotekeka, harĩa kĩaga gĩakĩtwo hakorwo na mĩtĩ ya kĩruru nĩgetha hakorwo hehu hĩndĩ ya riũa.
english: Where possible, the land should have some trees and grass cover for shade to cool the poultry houses during hot periods

kikuyu: Mambarita magĩrĩire kũrathwo na mũhianĩre wa v, nĩguo maaĩ magaikũrũka wega, magitwo na mabati, mĩnyore kana nyeki.
english: The roof should be v-shaped (for easy flow of rainwater) made of iron sheets, plastic sheets with papyrus or grass thatched.

kikuyu: ũkihuthira cindano na syringe ĩyo, tahia gĩcambicũri kĩrĩa kĩrahũthĩka kũringia njanjo.
english: Using the needle fixed to a syringe, withdraw some or all of diluent to be used to dilute the vaccine into the syringe through the needle

kikuyu: Onoreria cuba-inĩ ĩrĩa ĩna njanjo ũthecete gakunĩko ka raba na ũtukanie ũmenyereire.
english: Inject into the vaccine vial in the middle of the rubber stopper and mix gently (if vacuum is still intact, it will pull some of the liquid into the vial without any pressure from the vaccinator)

kikuyu: Mwerekera wa kũhe ngũkũ njanjo ya Newcastle thĩinĩ wa maaĩ nĩ ũrĩkũ?
english: What are the direction for giving Newcastle vaccine in drinking water

kikuyu: Thuthuria wone ngũkũ ciothe nĩiranyua maaĩ, na angĩkorwo imwe itiranyua, thongithia mĩharatĩ ĩyo ya maaĩ ũndũ ĩgũkinyĩrwo nĩ ngũkũ ciothe.
english: Check to ensure all the birds are drinking water, if not, redistribute the drinkers as necessary

kikuyu: Hinya wa rũrũ rwa gũciarithania kũrũa na mĩrimũ no kũhotomie hinya wa njanjo kũruta wĩra wega kũrĩ njiarwa.
english: The immune status of the parent flock also can contribute to a vaccine failure.

kikuyu: Njanjo yarĩkia kũringio, no mũhaka ĩhũthĩrwo ndagĩka-inĩ mĩrongo ĩtatũ nginya mĩrongo ĩna na ĩtano, nayo ĩrĩa ĩgũtigara ĩteo.
english: Once reconstituted, vaccines should be used within 30-45 minutes, any that remain should be discarded.

kikuyu: Mbeca nini cia kũambĩrĩra: Ũrĩithi wa ngũkũ cia gĩcenji ũbataraga mbeca nini gũciakĩra ona kũgũrĩra irio hĩndĩ ya kũambĩrĩria ũkĩringithania na iria ireragwo irĩ cia biacara na nĩũndũ ũcio arĩmi anini makahota gũcirĩithia.
english: Low Investment: Compared to their commercial counterparts, kienyeji chickens require less initial investment in housing and feed, making them accessible to small-scale farmers.

kikuyu: ũyũ nĩ mũthemba wa ngũkũ ũrĩa ũreragwo kaingĩ nĩ arĩmi aingĩ arĩa anini.
english: This is the most common type of chicken kept by many smallholder farmers

kikuyu: Ngũkũ ici ĩhingagĩrwo ciaga-inĩ na kaingĩ irĩaga irio cia kũgũrwo.
english: They are kept in chicken houses and mostly feed on commercial feeds.

kikuyu: Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Andũ arĩa mahĩbaga indo cia gũtunyana na indo cia ndaho kũu ciĩhitho-inĩ nũmu ciao, matiũĩ gwĩka ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire.”
english: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says Yahweh, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”

kikuyu: “Ndaatũmire mũhũte mũrĩ matũũra-inĩ manyu manene, na ngĩtũma mwage irio matũũra-inĩ, no rĩrĩ, inyuĩ mũtiigana kũnjookerera,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: “I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ arĩa mũgarũraga kĩhooto gĩgatuĩka ũrũrũ, na mũkarangĩrĩria ũthingu thĩ
english: You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth!

kikuyu: (we ũrĩa wombire njata iria ciĩtagwo Kĩrĩmĩra na Karaũ, o we ũrĩa ũgarũraga nduma ndumanu ĩgatuĩka rũciinĩ, na agatumania mũthenya ũgatuĩka ũtukũ, ũrĩa wĩtaga maaĩ ma iria rĩrĩa inene akamaitũrũra gũkũ thĩ-rĩ: Jehova nĩrĩo rĩĩtwa rĩake;
english: Seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, Yahweh is his name,

kikuyu: areehagĩra kĩĩhitho kĩrũmu mwanangĩko o rĩmwe ta rũheni, narĩo itũũra inene rĩrĩa rĩirigĩre akarĩanangithia),
english: who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.

kikuyu: Mũrangagĩrĩria mũthĩĩni, na mũkamũtunya ngano na hinya. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, o na gũtuĩka nĩmwakĩte nyũmba nene cia mahiga-rĩ, mũtigacitũũra; o na gũtuĩka nĩmũhaandĩte mĩgũnda mĩega ya mĩthabibũ-rĩ, mũtikanyua ndibei yayo.
english: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and take taxes from him of wheat, you have built houses of cut stone, but you will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.

kikuyu: Tondũ ũcio mũndũ ũrĩa mũbacĩrĩri no gũkira akiraga ki mahinda ta macio, tondũ nĩ mahinda mooru.
english: Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkaagĩa mũcakayo mĩgũnda-inĩ yothe ya mĩthabibũ, nĩgũkorwo nĩngatuĩkanĩria gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: In all vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through the middle of you,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: O na mũngĩndehera maruta ma njino, na maruta ma ngano-rĩ, ndikametĩkĩra. O na mũngĩkarehe maruta marĩa mega ma ũiguano-rĩ, ndikamarũmbũiya.
english: Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ mũtĩĩragia mũthenya wa ũũru, na mũkareharehe wathani wa ũhinya ũkuhĩrĩrie.
english: Alas for you who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near,

kikuyu: Mũkomagĩra marĩrĩ magemetio na mĩguongo, na mũgetambũrũkia itanda-inĩ cianyu. Mũrĩĩaga tũgondu tũrĩa twega mũno, na tũcaũ tũrĩa tũnoru.
english: who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the middle of the stall,

kikuyu: Ciarĩkia kũrĩa tũhuti tuothe, bũrũri ũgĩthera biũ, ngĩkaya ngiuga atĩrĩ, “Mwathani Jehova, marekere! Jakubu-rĩ, angĩhonoka gĩkuũ atĩa? Nĩgũkorwo nĩ mũnini mũno!”
english: When they finished eating the grass of the land, then I said, “Lord Yahweh, forgive, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”

kikuyu: Ndũkaarathĩre ũhoro rĩngĩ gũkũ Betheli tondũ gũkũ nĩkuo kwamũrĩirwo gĩikaro kĩa mũthamaki na hekarũ ya ũthamaki.”
english: but don’t prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house!”

kikuyu: Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ, “Matukũ nĩmarooka, “rĩrĩa mũgethi agaakorererwo nĩ mũciimbi, nake mũhaandi akorererwo nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũhihaga thabibũ. Ndibei ya mũhihano ĩgaatataga kuuma irĩma-inĩ, na ĩthererage kuuma tũrĩma-inĩ tuothe.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the one treading grapes him who sows seed; and sweet wine will drip from the mountains, and flow from the hills.

kikuyu: Kushi nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Nimurodi ũrĩa wakũrire agĩtuĩka njamba ya ita ĩrĩ hinya thĩinĩ wa thĩ.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

kikuyu: na Aarivadi, na Azemari, na Ahamathi.
english: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

kikuyu: na Serugu, na Nahoru, na Tera,
english: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

kikuyu: na Jeturu, na Nafishu, na Kedema. Acio nĩo maarĩ ariũ a Ishumaeli.
english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Ezeri maarĩ: Bilihani, na Zaavani, na Akani. Ariũ a Dishani maarĩ: Uzu, na Arani.
english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Hushamu aakuire, Hadadi mũrũ wa Bedadi ũrĩa wahootire Midiani kũu bũrũri wa Moabi, agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake. Itũũra rĩake inene rĩetagwo Avithu.
english: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.

kikuyu: Ramu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Aminadabu, nake Aminadabu aarĩ ithe wa Nahashoni, ũrĩa warĩ mũtongoria wa andũ a Juda.
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

kikuyu: Abigaili nĩwe warĩ nyina wa Amasa, na ithe wa Amasa aarĩ Jetheri ũrĩa Mũishumaeli.
english: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Nadabu maarĩ: Seledi na Apaimu. No rĩrĩ, Seledi aakuire atarĩ na ciana.
english: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

kikuyu: nake Zabadi nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Efilali, nake Efilali nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Obedi,
english: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Solomoni eetagwo Rehoboamu, nake mũriũ eetagwo Abija, nake Asa aarĩ mũriũ wa Abija, nake Jehoshafatu aarĩ mũriũ wa Asa,
english: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

kikuyu: nake Amazia aarĩ mũriũ wa Joashu, nake Azaria aarĩ mũriũ wa Amazia, nake Jothamu aarĩ mũriũ wa Azaria,
english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

kikuyu: Njiaro cia Hanania ciarĩ: Pelatia, na Jeshaia, na ningĩ nĩ kwarĩ na ariũ a Rafaia, na a Arinani, na a Obadia, o na a Shekania.
english: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

kikuyu: Jabezu aarĩ mũtĩĩku mũno gũkĩra ariũ a nyina. Nyina nĩwe wamũtuire Jabezu, tondũ oigire atĩrĩ, “Ndaamũciarire na ruo.”
english: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

kikuyu: Ariũ a Kalebu, mũrũ wa Jefune, maarĩ: Iru, na Ela, na Naamu. Mũriũ wa Ela eetagwo: Kenazu.
english: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

kikuyu: Ariũ a mũtumia wa Hodia (mwarĩ wa nyina na Nahamu) maarĩ: Ithe wa Keila ũrĩa Mũgarimi, na Eshitemoa ũrĩa Mũmaakathi.
english: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

kikuyu: na Bethi-Marikabothu, na Hazari-Susimu, na Bethi-Biri, na Shaaraimu. Macio nĩmo maarĩ matũũra mao nginya rĩrĩa Daudi aathamakaga.
english: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

kikuyu: na Ziza mũrũ wa Shifi, mũrũ wa Aloni, mũrũ wa Jedaia, mũrũ wa Shimuri, mũrũ wa Shemaia.
english: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

kikuyu: na mũriũ Mika, na mũriũ Reaia, na mũriũ Baali,
english: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ya wathani wa Saũlũ nĩmarũire na Ahagari, na makĩmahoota; nao makĩĩnyiitĩra ciikaro cia Ahagari acio rũgongo-inĩ ruothe rwa mwena wa irathĩro wa Gileadi.
english: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

kikuyu: Andũ ao kũringana na nyũmba ciao maarĩ: Mikaeli, na Meshulamu, na Sheba, na Jorai, na Jakani, na Zia, na Eberi, othe maarĩ andũ mũgwanja.
english: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

kikuyu: Acio nĩo maarĩ ariũ a Abihaili mũrũ wa Huru, mũrũ wa Jaroa, mũrũ wa Gileadi, mũrũ wa Mikaeli, mũrũ wa Jeshishai, mũrũ wa Jahido, mũrũ wa Buzi.
english: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

kikuyu: Nao makĩhithũkĩra Ahagari, na Ajeturi, na Anafishi, na Anodabu.
english: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Ngai wa Isiraeli akĩarahũra roho wa Puli mũthamaki wa Ashuri (ũguo nĩ kuuga Tigilathu-Pileseru, mũthamaki wa Ashuri), ũrĩa watahire andũ a Rubeni, na andũ a Gadi, na nuthu ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase, akĩmatwara ithaamĩrio. Akĩmathaamĩria Hala, na Habori, na Hara, na rũũĩ-inĩ rwa Gozani, kũrĩa matũire nginya ũmũthĩ.
english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Kohathu maarĩ: Amuramu, na Iziharu, na Hebironi, na Uzieli.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kikuyu: na Ahitubu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Zadoku, na Zadoku nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Ahimaazu,
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.

kikuyu: na Ahimaazu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Azaria, na Azaria nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Johanani,
english: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

kikuyu: nake Elikana aarĩ mũriũ wa Asiru, nake Ebiasafu aarĩ mũriũ wa Elikana, nake Asiru aarĩ mũriũ wa Ebiasafu,
english: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

kikuyu: nake Zadoku aarĩ mũriũ wa Ahitubu, nake Ahimaazu aarĩ mũriũ wa Zadoku.
english: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

kikuyu: Maaheirwo Hebironi kũu Juda, o hamwe na ũrĩithio ũrĩa warigiicĩirie.
english: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ a Isiraeli makĩhe Alawii matũũra macio na ũrĩithio wamo.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: na Jokimeamu, na Bethi-Horoni,
english: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Uzi aarĩ: Izirahia. Ariũ a Izirahia maarĩ: Mikaeli, na Obadia, na Joeli, na Ishia. Othe atano maarĩ anene a andũ ao.
english: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Jediaeli aarĩ: Bilihani. Ariũ a Bilihani maarĩ: Jeushu, na Benjamini, na Ehudu, na Kenaana, na Zethani, na Tarishishi, na Ahishaharu.
english: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Ulamu eetagwo: Bedani. Acio nĩo maarĩ ariũ a Gileadi mũrũ wa Makiru, mũrũ wa Manase.
english: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Acio othe maarĩ njiaro cia Asheri; nĩo maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao, na andũ athuure, na njamba cia ita, na atongoria arĩa maarĩ igweta. Mũigana wa andũ arĩa maangĩathiire mbaara kũringana na maandĩko ma njiarwa ciao maarĩ 26,000.
english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

kikuyu: na Gera, na Shefufani, na Huramu.
english: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

kikuyu: na Beria, na Shema arĩa maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba cia arĩa maatũũraga Aijaloni, na nĩo maingatire andũ arĩa maatũũraga Gathu.
english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, andũ arĩa maambire gũcooka gũikara mĩgũnda-inĩ yao o kũu matũũra-inĩ mao, maarĩ andũ amwe a Isiraeli, na athĩnjĩri-Ngai, na Alawii, na ndungata cia hekarũ.
english: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa maatũũraga Jerusalemu kuuma Juda, na Benjamini, na Efiraimu, na Manase maarĩ:
english: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

kikuyu: Andũ a Shiloni maarĩ: Asaia ũrĩa warĩ irigithathi, na ariũ ake.
english: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

kikuyu: Kuuma Zera aarĩ: Jeueli. Andũ othe a kuuma Juda maarĩ 690.
english: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

kikuyu: Andũ a Benjamini maarĩ: Salu mũrũ wa Meshulamu, mũrũ wa Hodavia, mũrũ wa Hasenua;
english: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

kikuyu: Athĩnjĩri-Ngai arĩa maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao maarĩ 1,760. Maarĩ arũme maarĩ na ũhoti, na nĩ meehokeirwo gũtungata nyũmba-inĩ ya Ngai.
english: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa andũ a Isiraeli othe arĩa maarĩ kĩanda moonire atĩ ita nĩrĩorĩte, na atĩ Saũlũ na ariũ ake nĩmakuĩte-rĩ, magĩtiganĩria matũũra mao, makĩũra; nao Afilisti magĩthiĩ magĩikara kuo.
english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

kikuyu: Makĩiga indo cia Saũlũ cia mbaara thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ya ngai ciao, naguo mũtwe wake makĩwoherera kũu hekarũ ya Dagoni.
english: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

kikuyu: Saũlũ aakuire nĩ ũndũ ndaarĩ mwĩhokeku kũrĩ Jehova; ndaamenyereire kiugo kĩa Jehova, o na nĩahooire kĩrĩra kuuma kũrĩ mũragũri atĩ amũtongorie,
english: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Yahweh, because of Yahweh’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

kikuyu: Nake agĩaka itũũra inene rĩthiũrũrũkĩirie gĩikaro kĩu, kuuma benji-inĩ nginya rũthingo-inĩ rũrĩa rwakĩrigiicĩirie, nake Joabu agĩcookereria mĩena ĩrĩa ĩngĩ ya itũũra rĩu inene.
english: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

kikuyu: Anene atatũ a acio mĩrongo ĩtatũ, nĩmaikũrũkire magĩthiĩ kũrĩ Daudi ihiga-inĩ rĩrĩa rĩarĩ ngurunga-inĩ ya Adulamu, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mbũtũ ya Afilisti yaambĩte hema Kĩanda kĩa Refaimu.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: na Ithai mũrũ wa Ribai, wa kuuma Gibea kũu Benjamini, na Benaia ũrĩa Mũpirathoni,
english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

kikuyu: na Hanani mũrũ wa Maaka, na Joshafatu ũrĩa Mũmithini,
english: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

kikuyu: na Elieli ũrĩa Mũmahavi, na Jeribai na Joshavia, ariũ a Elinaamu, na Ithima ũrĩa Mũmoabi,
english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

kikuyu: Andũ amwe a kuuma Benjamini na angĩ a kuuma Juda o nao magĩũka kũrĩ Daudi kũu kĩĩhitho-inĩ gĩake.
english: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Roho agĩikũrũkĩra Amasai, mũnene wa arĩa Mĩrongo Ĩtatũ, akiuga atĩrĩ: “Tũrĩ aku, wee Daudi! Tũrĩ hamwe nawe, wee mũrũ wa Jesii! Ũrogaacĩra, ũgaacĩre ki, na arĩa magũteithagia marogaacĩra, nĩgũkorwo Ngai waku nĩegũgũteithia.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Daudi akĩmaamũkĩra na akĩmatua atongoria a mbũtũ ciake cia gũtharĩkĩra thũ.
english: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

kikuyu: Andũ amwe a Manase nĩmagarũrũkire magĩthiĩ mwena wa Daudi rĩrĩa aathiire na Afilisti kũhũũrana na Saũlũ. (Daudi na andũ ake matiateithirie Afilisti, tondũ thuutha wa kwaranĩria, aathani ao nĩmamũingatire. Maamwĩrire atĩrĩ, “Tũkaarĩha na mĩoyo iitũ angĩgatũtiganĩria acookerere mwathi wake Saũlũ.”)
english: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”

kikuyu: andũ a Benjamini, na nĩo maarĩ a mbarĩ ĩmwe na Saũlũ, maarĩ 3,000; aingĩ ao maatũũrĩte maathĩkagĩra nyũmba ya Saũlũ, o nginya hĩndĩ ĩyo;
english: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Daudi na andũ ake makĩambata, magĩthiĩ nginya Baali-Perazimu, na akĩmatooreria kuo. Nake akiuga atĩrĩ, “O ta ũrĩa maaĩ moinaga, noguo Ngai aharaganĩtie thũ ciakwa na guoko gwakwa.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio handũ hau hagĩĩtwo Baali-Perazimu.
english: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Daudi agĩĩta Zadoku na Abiatharu arĩa athĩnjĩri-Ngai, na Urieli, na Asaia, na Joeli, na Shemaia, na Elieli, na Aminadabu arĩa Alawii.
english: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,

kikuyu: Zekaria, na Azieli, na Shemiramothu, na Jehieli, na Uni, na Eliabu, na Maaseia, na Benaia maarĩ a kũhũũra inanda cia kĩnũbi, kũringana na Alamothu.
english: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;

kikuyu: Ririkanai magegania marĩa ekĩte, na ciama ciake, na matuĩro ma ciira marĩa atuĩte,
english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

kikuyu: moorũũraga kuuma rũrĩrĩ rũmwe nginya rũrĩa rũngĩ, na kuuma ũthamaki-inĩ ũmwe nginya ũrĩa ũngĩ.
english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

kikuyu: Inĩrai Jehova, inyuĩ andũ a thĩ yothe; mũhunjagie ũhonokio wake mũthenya o mũthenya.
english: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.

kikuyu: Riiri na ũnene irĩ mbere yake; hinya na gĩkeno itũũraga gwake.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.

kikuyu: Daudi agĩtiga Zadoku ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai hamwe na athĩnjĩri-Ngai arĩa angĩ hau mbere ya hema ĩrĩa nyamũre, kũndũ kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru kũu Gibeoni,
english: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before Yahweh’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,

kikuyu: Ũcio nĩwe ũkaanjakĩra nyũmba, na nĩngahaanda gĩtĩ gĩake kĩa ũnene nginya tene.
english: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

kikuyu: Na ta ũndũ ũcio ũrĩ o mũnini maitho-inĩ maku, Wee Ngai-rĩ, nĩwarĩtie ũhoro wa matukũ marĩa magooka makoniĩ nyũmba ya ndungata yaku. Na rĩu Wee Jehova Ngai, ũnyonete ta ndĩ mũndũ ũmwe wa arĩa atũũgĩrie mũno.
english: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, Yahweh God.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Daudi nĩahũũranire na Hadadezeri mũthamaki wa Zoba, akĩmũingata akĩmũkinyia Hamathu, rĩrĩa mũthamaki ũcio aathiiaga gũtũma wathani wake ũrũme wega ndwere-inĩ cia Rũũĩ rwa Farati.
english: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

kikuyu: Kuuma matũũra ma Teba na Kuni marĩa maarĩ ma Hadadezeri, Daudi agĩtunyana gĩcango kĩingĩ mũno kĩrĩa Solomoni aahũthĩrire gũthondeka Karia ga gĩcango, na itugĩ, na mĩthemba mĩingĩ ya indo cia gĩcango.
english: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: Benaia mũrũ wa Jehoiada nĩwe warĩ mũnene wa Akerethi na Apelethi; nao ariũ a Daudi nĩo maarĩ atongoria na anene a gũikaranagia na mũthamaki.
english: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.

kikuyu: Andũ acio angĩ akĩmaiga watho-inĩ wa Abishai mũrũ wa nyina. Nao akĩmatũma makarũe na andũ a Amoni.
english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ndungata cia Hadadezeri cionire atĩ nĩmahootwo nĩ Isiraeli-rĩ, magĩthondeka thayũ na Daudi, nao magĩtuĩka a gwathagwo nĩwe. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Asuriata matiacookire gwĩtĩkĩra gũteithia Aamoni rĩngĩ.
english: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

kikuyu: Mahinda macio-rĩ, gũkĩgĩa mbaara ya kũrũa na Afilisti kũu Gezeri. Hĩndĩ ĩyo Sibekai ũrĩa Mũhushathi akĩũraga Sipai, ũmwe wa njiaro cia Refai, nao Afilisti magĩtoorio biũ.
english: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Daudi akĩĩra Ngai atĩrĩ, “Nĩnjĩhĩtie mũno nĩ gwĩka ũndũ ũyũ. Rĩu ndagũthaitha ũnjehererie mahĩtia, niĩ ndungata yaku. Nĩnjĩkĩte ũndũ wa ũrimũ mũno.”
english: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”

kikuyu: Ũthuure mĩaka ĩtatũ ya ngʼaragu, kana mĩeri ĩtatũ ya kũniinwo nĩ thũ ciaku igũthingatĩte na hiũ ciao cia njora, kana mĩthenya ĩtatũ ya rũhiũ rwa njora rwa Jehova, naguo nĩ atĩ kũgĩe na mĩthenya ya mũthiro bũrũri-inĩ, rĩrĩa mũraika wa Jehova akaaniinana Isiraeli guothe.’ Na rĩrĩ, tua itua ũnjĩĩre ũrĩa ngũthiĩ gũcookeria ũrĩa ũndũmĩte.”
english: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of Yahweh, even pestilence in the land, and Yahweh’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’ ”

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩarĩria mũraika ũcio nake agĩcookia rũhiũ rwake njora.
english: Then Yahweh commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Daudi ndangĩathiire mbere yakĩo gũtuĩria ũhoro harĩ Ngai tondũ nĩetigagĩra rũhiũ rwa njora rwa mũraika ũcio wa Jehova.
english: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of Yahweh’s angel.

kikuyu: Nake akĩruta igera nyingĩ cia gũthondeka mĩcumarĩ ya mĩrango ya ihingo na ya kũnyiitithania indo cia nyũmba thĩinĩ, na gĩcango kĩingĩ gĩtangĩthimĩka.
english: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩruta mĩgogo ya mĩtarakwa ĩtangĩtarĩka, nĩgũkorwo andũ a Sidoni na a Turo nĩmareheire Daudi mĩgogo mĩingĩ.
english: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Amuramu maarĩ: Harũni na Musa. Harũni nĩamũrirwo hamwe na njiaro ciake nginya tene, nĩgeetha maamũrage indo iria theru mũno, na marutagĩre Jehova magongona, na mamũtungatagĩre, na marathimanage thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩake nginya tene.
english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before Yahweh, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

kikuyu: Njiaro cia Eliezeri nĩ: Rehabia na nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao. Eliezeri ndaarĩ na ariũ angĩ, no ariũ a Rehabia maarĩ aingĩ mũno.
english: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Mushi maarĩ: Mahali, na Ederi, na Jeremothu; othe maarĩ atatũ.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

kikuyu: Acio nĩo maarĩ njiaro cia Lawi kũringana na nyũmba ciao: na nĩo maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao ta ũrĩa marĩĩtwa mao maandĩkĩtwo, na maatarirwo mũndũ o mũndũ, ũguo nĩ kuuga aruti a wĩra arĩa maarĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na makĩria, arĩa maatungataga hekarũ-inĩ ya Jehova.
english: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of Yahweh’s house, from twenty years old and upward.

kikuyu: Ningĩ marũgamage o rũciinĩ gũcookeria Jehova ngaatho na kũmũgooca. Ningĩ magekaga ũguo o hwaĩ- inĩ,
english: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahweh, and likewise in the evening;

kikuyu: na rĩrĩa rĩothe maruta ma njino mangĩarutĩirwo Jehova, mĩthenya ya Thabatũ, na ciathĩ cia Karũgamo ka Mweri, na ciathĩ iria ingĩ ciathanĩtwo. No nginya matungatage mbere ya Jehova mahinda mothe marĩ mũigana ũrĩa ũtuĩtwo, ningĩ na njĩra ĩrĩa maathĩtwo marutage nayo.
english: and to offer all burnt offerings to Yahweh on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before Yahweh;

kikuyu: Zadoku wa rũciaro rwa Eleazaru na Ahimeleku wa rũciaro rwa Ithamaru nĩo maateithĩrĩirie Daudi kũmagayania ikundi, nĩ ũndũ wa mũtaratara wa ũtungata ũrĩa maathuurĩirwo.
english: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

kikuyu: na wa ikũmi na ũmwe kũrĩ Eliashibu, na wa ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ kũrĩ Jakimu,
english: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

kikuyu: na wa ikũmi na kenda kũrĩ Pethahia, na wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ kũrĩ Jehezekeli,
english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

kikuyu: na wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ũmwe kũrĩ Jakini, na wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na igĩrĩ kũrĩ Gamuli,
english: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩguo warĩ mũtaratara wa ũtungata wao rĩrĩa maatoonya hekarũ ya Jehova, kũringana na watho ũrĩa maatuĩrĩirwo nĩ ithe wao Harũni, ta ũrĩa Jehova Ngai wa Isiraeli aamwathĩte.
english: This was their ordering in their service, to come into Yahweh’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a Hemani: maarĩ Bukia, na Matania, na Uzieli, na Shubaeli, na Jerimothu, na Hanania, na Hanani, na Eliatha, na Gidaliti, na Romamuti-Ezeri, na Joshibekasha, na Malothi, na Hothiru, na Mahaziothu.
english: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

kikuyu: wa ikũmi na ũmwe wagũĩrĩire Azareli, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: wa ikũmi na ĩtandatũ wagũĩrĩire Hanania, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
english: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Ariũ a Meshelemia maarĩ: Zekaria, na nĩwe warĩ wa irigithathi, na Jediaeli aarĩ wa keerĩ, na Zebadia aarĩ wa gatatũ, na Jathinieli aarĩ wa kana,
english: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

kikuyu: Mũriũ Shemaia o nake aarĩ na ariũ ake, arĩa maarĩ atongoria thĩinĩ wa nyũmba ya ithe wao, tondũ maarĩ andũ ehoti.
english: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

kikuyu: Mũnene wa mũgwanja wa mweri wa mũgwanja, aarĩ Helezu ũrĩa Mũpeloni, wa rũciaro rwa Efiraimu. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
english: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Mũnene wa kanana, wa mweri wa ĩnana, aarĩ Sibekai ũrĩa Mũhushathi wa rũciaro rwa Azerahi. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
english: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: mũnene wa nuthu ĩrĩa ingĩ ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase kũu Gileadi aarĩ Ido mũrũ wa Zekaria; mũnene wa mũhĩrĩga wa Benjamini aarĩ Jaasieli mũrũ wa Abineri;
english: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

kikuyu: Daudi ndaatarire andũ a mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na arĩa mataakinyĩtie, tondũ Jehova nĩeranĩire atĩ nĩakaingĩhia Isiraeli matuĩke o ta njata cia matu-inĩ.
english: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because Yahweh had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.

kikuyu: Joabu mũrũ wa Zeruia nĩambĩrĩirie gũtara andũ, no ndaarĩkirie. Mangʼũrĩ nĩmakinyĩire Isiraeli nĩ ũndũ wa itarana rĩu. Naguo mũigana wa itarana rĩu ndwandĩkirwo ibuku-inĩ rĩa maũndũ ma Mũthamaki Daudi.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Mũthamaki Daudi akĩĩra kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe atĩrĩ: “Mũriũ wakwa Solomoni, ũrĩa Ngai athuurĩte, nĩ mwĩthĩ na ndarĩ na ũmenyo wa kũigana. Wĩra ũyũ nĩ mũnene, tondũ nyũmba ĩno ĩhaana ta ya ũthamaki ti ya mũndũ no nĩ ya Jehova Ngai.
english: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for Yahweh God.

kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe warĩ na tũhiga twa goro nĩatũheanire thĩinĩ wa kĩgĩĩna kĩa hekarũ ya Jehova kĩrĩa kĩamenyagĩrĩrwo nĩ Jehieli ũrĩa Mũgerishoni.
english: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of Yahweh’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

kikuyu: Daudi nĩagoocire Jehova arĩ mbere ya kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ũrogoocwo wee, o Wee Jehova, Ngai wa ithe witũ Isiraeli, kuuma tene nginya tene.
english: Therefore David blessed Yahweh before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, Yahweh, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

kikuyu: Niĩ nĩnjũũĩ atĩ Wee Ngai wakwa nĩũtuĩragia ngoro, na nĩũkenagio nĩ ũrũngĩrĩru wa ngoro. Indo ici ciothe ndĩciheanĩte na kwĩyendera na wĩhokeku. Na rĩu ndĩ na gĩkeno nĩ ũndũ wa kwĩonera ũrĩa andũ aya aku marĩ haha makũrutĩire indo na wendo.
english: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Solomoni agĩikarĩra gĩtĩ gĩa ũthamaki kĩa Jehova, na agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩa ithe Daudi. Nake akĩgaacĩra na agĩathĩkĩrwo Isiraeli guothe.
english: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Yahweh as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

kikuyu: Solomoni, mũrũ wa Daudi, nĩehaandire akĩrũma wega ũthamaki-inĩ wake, nĩgũkorwo Jehova Ngai wake aarĩ hamwe nake na akĩmũnenehia mũno makĩria.
english: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and Yahweh his God was with him, and made him exceedingly great.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, rĩu ndĩ hakuhĩ gwaka hekarũ ĩtanĩtio na Rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova Ngai wakwa na ndĩmĩamũre ĩtuĩke yake ya gũcinagĩra ũbumba ũrĩa ũtararĩkaga wega mbere yake, o na ya kũigagwo mĩgate ĩrĩa mĩamũre mahinda mothe, na ya kũrutagĩra magongona ma njino o rũciinĩ, na hwaĩ-inĩ, na mĩthenya ya Thabatũ, na hĩndĩ ya Tũrũgamo twa Mweri na ciathĩ iria nyamũre cia Jehova Ngai witũ. Ũyũ nĩ watho mwandĩke wa Isiraeli wa gũtũũra nginya tene.
english: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of sweet spices, for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts of Yahweh our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.

kikuyu: nĩgeetha ũnyonere mbaũ nyingĩ, tondũ hekarũ ĩrĩa ngwaka no nginya ĩkorwo ĩrĩ nene na ĩrĩ thaka mũno.
english: even to prepare timber in abundance for me; for the house which I am about to build will be great and wonderful.

kikuyu: Nĩngaahe ndungata ciaku iria ciatũũraga mbaũ kori 20,000 cia mũtu wa ngano, na kori 20,000 cia cairi, na mbathi 20,000 cia ndibei, na mbathi 20,000 cia maguta ma mĩtamaiyũ.”
english: Behold, I will give to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand cors of beaten wheat, twenty thousand baths of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.”

kikuyu: “Rĩu-rĩ, mwathi wakwa nĩagĩtũmĩre ndungata ciake ngano na cairi, na maguta ma mĩtamaiyũ na ndibei iria eranĩire,
english: “Now therefore, the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants;

kikuyu: Ũraihu wa mathagu ma makerubi wothe warĩ mĩkono mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ. Ithagu rĩmwe rĩa ikerubi rĩa mbere rĩarĩ rĩa mĩkono ĩtano kũraiha na rĩkahutia rũthingo rwa hekarũ, narĩo ithagu rĩu rĩngĩ o narĩo rĩarĩ rĩa mĩkono ĩtano kũraiha na rĩkahutia ithagu rĩa ikerubi rĩu rĩngĩ.
english: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

kikuyu: Mathagu ma makerubi maya maarĩ na ũraihu wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ. Maicũhĩtio marũgamĩte na magũrũ, na mangʼetheire nyũmba nene.
english: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

kikuyu: Solomoni nĩathondekire gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩa ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ na gĩa gatani ĩrĩa njega, na mĩhiano ya makerubi nĩyatumĩrĩirwo gĩtambaya-inĩ kĩu.
english: He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka agĩaka itangi inene mũno rĩrĩa rĩetagwo Karia rĩa kĩgera gĩtwekie, na rĩarĩ rĩa gĩthiũrũrĩ, na rĩarĩ rĩa mĩkono ikũmi kuuma mwena ũmwe wa mũromo nginya ũrĩa ũngĩ, na mĩkono ĩtano kũraiha na igũrũ. Rĩathimwo gĩthiũrũrĩ kĩarĩo rĩathiũrũrũkĩirio nĩ rũrigi rwa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtatũ.
english: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.

kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩthondeka iraĩ ikũmi cia gwĩthambĩra, na akĩiga ithano mwena wa gũthini na ithano mwena wa gathigathini. Indo iria ciahũthagĩrwo nĩ ũndũ wa magongona ma njino ciathambagĩrio thĩinĩ wacio, no Karia kau geethambagĩrwo nĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai.
english: He also made ten basins, and put five on the right hand and five on the left, to wash in them. The things that belonged to the burnt offering were washed in them, but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

kikuyu: Karia na mĩhiano ya ndegwa iria ikũmi na igĩrĩ rungu rwako;
english: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo ũkaamaigua ũrĩ o kũu igũrũ na ũrekere andũ aku a Isiraeli mehia mao na ũmacookie bũrũri ũrĩa wamaheire hamwe na maithe mao.
english: then hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

kikuyu: “Rĩrĩa igũrũ rĩkaahingwo, na mbura yaage kuura tondũ wa ũrĩa andũ aku makũhĩtĩirie, mangĩkaahooya marorete handũ haha, na moimbũre rĩĩtwa rĩaku na magarũrũke matigane na mehia mao tondũ nĩũmanyamarĩtie-rĩ,
english: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

kikuyu: “Ha ũhoro wa mũndũ wa kũngĩ ũrĩa ũtarĩ wa andũ aku a Isiraeli no nĩ oimĩte bũrũri wa kũraya nĩ ũndũ wa ngumo ya rĩĩtwa rĩaku inene na ũhoro wa ciĩko cia guoko gwaku kũrĩ hinya gũtambũrũkĩtio, rĩrĩa agooka ahooe erekeire hekarũ ĩno,
english: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes from a far country for your great name’s sake and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm, when they come and pray toward this house,

kikuyu: Nake Mũthamaki Solomoni akĩruta igongona rĩa ngʼombe 22,000 na rĩa ngʼondu na mbũri 120,000. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũthamaki na andũ othe makĩamũra hekarũ ya Ngai.
english: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated God’s house.
